title: Lantidra (donislecel-jujn) Prescribing Information
authors_or_organization: U.S. National Library of Medicine, DailyMed
notes: Label reports insulin independence in 25/30 subjects at any point, including 21/30 for at least one year and 9/30 for >5 years; follow-up was 0.3–14.5 years after first infusion. It reports serious reactions in 27/30, two deaths (both subjects were receiving immunosuppression at event), and loss of islet-cell function after immunosuppression discontinuation in 8/30. FDA's approval announcement reports 10 with >5 years; this comparison retains the label's 9.

title: Potency Assurance for Cellular and Gene Therapy Products
notes: Nonbinding draft guidance recommends a multifaceted potency-assurance strategy spanning manufacturing process design/control, material control, in-process testing, and lot-release assays. title: Single-cell transcriptomics of primary human pancreatic islet cells exposed to stress conditions associated with beta-cell failure
notes: GSE218316 official text record reports primary islets from three non-diabetic donors and in-vitro stressors with untreated controls at 24/72 h (BioProject PRJNA903151). On 2026-10-22, HTTP HEAD requests to all six listed GEO FTP files returned 200; processed per-cell metadata (23,845 rows; donor/condition/timepoint fields) was streamed and inspected, as was the filtered matrix header (33,540 features x 23,845 barcodes; 74,226,864 nonzero entries). For hypoxia, only D2 and D3 are represented at either timepoint; D1 lacks hypoxia. Counts are cells, not independent replicates. The 382 MB raw archive, full matrix payload, and barcodes/features/HTO contents were not inspected; this does not establish analysis readiness or independent validation. NCBI's Molecular Data Usage policy says NCBI places no restrictions on molecular-data use but disclaims transfer of submitter/third-party rights; GEO has no separate license field. The linked Frontiers article, DOI 10.3389/fimmu.2024.1381319, is CC BY 4.0. Cite GEO and the original study and check file-specific notices. In-vitro non-diabetic donor stress data are not clinical graft/device outcomes.
